name: The Ravaged Caravan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
narrative.objectives: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Hail, adventurer. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 8 to 12, 2,575 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.

quests.name: The Venture Co.
quests.objectiveText: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co.

quests.name: Supervisor Fizsprocket
quests.objectiveText: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
